findings.title: Winter rains threaten 1,000 Gaza shelter sites, councils warn
findings.location: Gaza Strip; al-Mughraqa and al-Zahra, central Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced households and shelter infrastructure. Union of Gaza Strip Municipalities warned of flooding risk at approximately 1,000 displacement sites, need to replace 200,000 tents, and collapse risk at more than 2,000 damaged buildings. Drainage damage and pump shortages limit response. These are risk and need estimates, not newly observed damage.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: winter rains could flood about 1,000 camps and other sites hosting displaced Palestinians
findings.source_type: Established reporting attributed to municipal union

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct Al Jazeera Palestine topic page and full linked November 25 report; compared with 19 authenticated prior watch heartbeats.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Prior 10:44 heartbeat excluded automated secondary flood-warning summary without direct source verification. Full report now recovered and attributable; older publication, not an event within the last hour.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Municipal union estimates not independently corroborated in this run; no new flooding or displacement confirmed.
